title: house
summary: Same building, different names. Which words share a history?
question: Does the same meaning mean the same root?
completion: House comes through Middle English hous from Old English hūs. German Haus and Old Norse hús are cousins. Casa and maison name the same thing, but follow Latin word histories instead.
partner: A similar sound is a clue. Let’s check the evidence.
